summary: Frontend testing of /compliance-library redesign plus regression check on /standards/16-deadly-sins. Previous iteration 121 issues on /standards/16-deadly-sins are now fixed ($499 price removed, footer REQUEST ADMISSION link present). Main new issues found on /compliance-library: domain product card buy buttons are still BUTTON elements calling Stripe checkout, not Link elements to /ground-0-briefing as required. Button text also shows 'ADD TO SYSTEM —' instead of 'REQUEST ACCESS →'.

ui_bugs.issue: buy-btn-lp-pkt-001, buy-btn-lp-pkt-dq, buy-btn-lp-pkt-002, buy-btn-lp-pkt-003, buy-btn-lp-pkt-004, buy-btn-lp-pkt-005 are BUTTON elements calling Stripe checkout (onClick -> buy(sku)), NOT Link elements to /ground-0-briefing as required. The spec says these must be 'Link elements to /ground-0-briefing — NOT Stripe checkout buttons'.

Domain card CTA button text shows 'ADD TO SYSTEM —' (empty price appended). Requirement says buttons should show 'REQUEST ACCESS →'. The code template is `ADD TO SYSTEM — ${card.price}` and card.price is '' so it renders as 'ADD TO SYSTEM —'.
bundle-hero-buy-btn is a BUTTON calling Stripe checkout (buy('LP-BDL-001')), not a Link. Per the redesign, all primary CTAs should route to /ground-0-briefing, not Stripe.
path-card-bundle in path chooser section calls buy('LP-BDL-001') Stripe checkout instead of linking to /ground-0-briefing.
buy-bundle-btn in 'two-path-band' section is a BUTTON calling Stripe checkout, not Link to /ground-0-briefing.

issues: LIBRARY nav item color is rgb(107, 114, 128) — appears gray/highlighted but same as other non-active links. May need an active/underline indicator to visually distinguish as highlighted.
